View 1462 Devonshire Crescent V6H 2G6 rent availability including the monthly rent price and browse photos of this 4 bed, 2 bath, 3680 Sq. Ft. house. 1462 Devonshire Crescent is currently on market.
Welcome to 1462 Devonshire Crescent, a beautifully preserved 100-year-old heritage residence in the heart of Shaughnessy. Across 3,680 square feet, this grand home blends original architectural character with updated interiors - four bedrooms, two and a half bathrooms, and a quiet, tree-lined setting in one of Vancouver's most established neighbourhoods.

The kitchen is built for real cooking: granite counters, a gas cooktop, stainless steel appliances, two prep areas, double sinks, and a breakfast area looking onto the garden. Multiple living spaces give the house room to breathe - a family room with a fireplace for everyday evenings, and a formal dining room seating eight for occasions that deserve it.

Bedrooms are bright and generously proportioned, each with large windows. The bathrooms are finished to a spa standard, with walk-in glass showers, a deep soaking tub, double vanities and premium fixtures throughout. Additional rooms adapt easily to a home office, nursery or guest space.

Shaughnessy puts you on a quiet, safe, upscale residential street minutes from Kerrisdale, South Granville, Kitsilano and downtown, with Devonshire Park close by.

In-unit laundry, detached garage, hardwood floors and garden. Cats and dogs welcome. Non-smoking. Available September 1 on a one-year lease. Please reach out to arrange a viewing.
